name: daicho
description: 自分専用の文献管理 Web アプリ (Cloudflare Workers + D1 + React)

scripts.deploy: npm run build && npm run deploy:ci
scripts.deploy:ci: npm run config:render && wrangler d1 migrations apply daicho --remote --config wrangler.deploy.toml && wrangler deploy --config wrangler.deploy.toml
scripts.check: tsc -p tsconfig.worker.json --noEmit && tsc -p tsconfig.web.json --noEmit && npm test
scripts.db:migrate: npm run config:render && wrangler d1 migrations apply daicho --remote --config wrangler.deploy.toml
